title: Sign Preview
description: Preview the sign (and the map in an item frame) you are looking at
body:
Hold the hotkey (defaults to <kbd>V</kbd>) to preview the sign or the map you are looking at.

This mod is a client-only mod for Fabric. [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) is required.

![A live demo of the mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b99c6d45feb59a06cec12d44fbe765567f7d25af.gif)

To change the max distance of previewing (defaults to 20 blocks), install [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) **AND** [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config), open the config screen from the mod menu and change the settings (or manually edit the configuration file `config/signpreview.json`).
